No horizontal scroll at 320px. - Real copy, not lorem ipsum. Loading, empty, error states must exist. - Keep nav menus, routes, and asset paths in a single config object at the top of the file so they can be extracted later. ## 9. Privacy Policy

How we handle your data. Clear, direct, and transparent.

Last Updated: November 4, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how [Your Legal Business Name] ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, and shares personal information when you visit our website at [Your Website URL] (the "Site") or engage in our aerial photography and cinematography services (the "Services").

We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your data. We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information to third parties for monetary or other valuable consideration.

1. Information We Collect

Information You Provide to Us

When you submit our contact form or communicate with us via email, we may collect:

  • Contact Data: Your name and email address.
  • Project Details: Information about the project you are inquiring about (e.g., real estate showcase, commercial FPV) and any details provided in your message, such as location or timeline.

Information Collected Automatically

When you visit the Site, our servers may automatically log standard technical data, including:

  • Usage Data: Your IP address, browser type, operating system, referring URLs, and the pages you view on the Site.
  • Cookies: We use essential cookies to ensure the Site functions properly. We do not employ cookies for targeted advertising or cross-site tracking.

2. How We Use Your Information

We utilize the information we collect for the following purposes:

  • Respond to Inquiries: To communicate with you regarding your project, provide quotes, and answer questions.
  • Provide Services: To perform the aerial photography and cinematography services you request.
  • Improve the Site: To monitor usage and ensure the Site is functioning correctly and securely.
  • Comply with Legal Obligations: To meet our legal obligations, such as FAA record-keeping requirements or responding to lawful requests from public authorities.

3. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)

If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA) or the UK, our legal basis for collecting and using your personal information depends on the data and the context:

  • Contractual Necessity: We need your information to respond to your inquiry and provide the Services you request.
  • Legitimate Interests: We have a legitimate interest in improving our Site, ensuring security, and communicating with prospective clients.
  • Legal Obligation: We may process your data to comply with applicable laws.

4. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share data only in the following limited circumstances:

  • Service Providers: We may use third-party tools for email communication or website hosting. These providers are bound by confidentiality agreements and process data solely on our behalf.
  • Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law or in response to a valid request by a public authority (e.g., a court or government agency).
  • Business Transfers: If we are involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will provide notice of any such change.

5. Data Retention

We retain your personal information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy. Project inquiry data is typically retained for [e.g., 12 months] to facilitate follow-up communications. We may retain certain records longer if required by law (e.g., tax or FAA compliance).

6. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:

  • Right to Access: You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
  • Right to Correction: You can ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Right to Deletion: You can request that we delete your personal data, subject to certain legal exceptions.
  • Right to Restrict Processing: You can ask us to limit how we use your data.
  • Right to Data Portability: You can request your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
  • Right to Opt-Out of Sale: We do not sell your data, but you have the right to opt out of any future sale. (We will never sell your data without explicit consent).

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at [Your Privacy Email Address]. We will respond to your request within the timeframe required by applicable law (typically 30 days for GDPR and 45 days for CCPA).

7. California Residents (CCPA/CPRA)

If you are a California resident, you have the right to know what personal information we collect, use, and disclose. You also have the right to request deletion of your personal information and to opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information. We do not sell or share your personal information as defined by the CCPA. To exercise your rights, contact us at [Your Privacy Email Address].

8. Children's Privacy

Our Site and Services are not directed to individuals under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have inadvertently collected data from a child, we will take steps to delete it.

9. Data Security

We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date at the top.
